 19class _MgcvSplineTerm(_MgcvTerm):
 20    """Univariate smooth term s(x, bs='tp', k=10)."""
 21
 22    def __init__(
 23        self,
 24        feature: int,
 25        k: int = 10,
 26        bs: str = "tp",
 27        sp: Optional[float] = None,
 28        m: Optional[Union[int, Tuple[int, int]]] = None,
 29        knots: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
 30        constraint: Optional[str] = None,
 31    ) -> None:
 32        self.feature = int(feature)
 33        self.k = int(k)
 34        self.bs = bs.lower()
 35        if constraint == "periodic" and self.bs == "tp":
 36            self.bs = "cc"
 37        self.sp = [float(sp)] if sp is not None else None
 38        self.m = m
 39        self.knots = knots
 40        self._Z: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 41        self._penalties: List[np.ndarray] = []
 42        self._meta: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 43        self.n_coefs = 0
 44
 45    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
 46        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature], dtype=float).ravel()
 47        X_raw, S_list, self._meta = build_smooth_basis(
 48            col, bs=self.bs, k=self.k, knots=self.knots, m=self.m
 49        )
 50        S_scaled, _ = rescale_penalty(X_raw, S_list)
 51        X_abs, self._penalties, self._Z = absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint(
 52            X_raw, S_scaled
 53        )
 54        self.n_coefs = X_abs.shape[1]
 55
 56    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 57        col = np.asarray(x[:, self.feature], dtype=float).ravel()
 58        if self._Z is None:
 59            self.compile(x)
 60        return predict_smooth_basis(col, self._meta) @ self._Z
 61
 62    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
 63        return [p.copy() for p in self._penalties]
 64
 65
 66class _MgcvTensorTerm(_MgcvTerm):
 67    """Tensor product smooth te(x1, x2, bs='cr', k=5)."""
 68
 69    def __init__(
 70        self,
 71        features: List[int],
 72        k: Union[int, List[int]] = 5,
 73        bs: Union[str, List[str]] = "cr",
 74        sp: Optional[Union[float, List[float]]] = None,
 75    ) -> None:
 76        self.features = [int(f) for f in features]
 77        self.d = len(self.features)
 78        if self.d < 2:
 79            raise ValueError(
 80                "Tensor product term requires at least 2 features."
 81            )
 82
 83        self.k_per = (
 84            [k] * self.d if isinstance(k, int) else [int(v) for v in k]
 85        )
 86        self.bs_per = (
 87            [bs] * self.d if isinstance(bs, str) else [str(v) for v in bs]
 88        )
 89        self.sp = (
 90            None
 91            if sp is None
 92            else [float(sp)] * self.d
 93            if isinstance(sp, (int, float))
 94            else [float(v) for v in sp]
 95        )
 96        self._Z: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 97        self._penalties: List[np.ndarray] = []
 98        self._marginal_meta: List[Dict] = []
 99        self.n_coefs = 0
100
101    def compile(self, x: np.ndarray) -> None:
102        marg_X, marg_S, self._marginal_meta = [], [], []
103        for i, feat in enumerate(self.features):
104            col = np.asarray(x[:, feat], dtype=float).ravel()
105            Xi, Si, meta_i = build_smooth_basis(
106                col, bs=self.bs_per[i], k=self.k_per[i]
107            )
108            ev_max = np.linalg.eigvalsh(Si[0])[-1]
109            if ev_max > 0:
110                Si[0] = Si[0] / ev_max
111            marg_X.append(Xi)
112            marg_S.append(Si[0])
113            self._marginal_meta.append(meta_i)
114
115        X_te = _khatri_rao(marg_X)
116        sizes = [m.shape[1] for m in marg_X]
117        TS_list = []
118        for i in range(self.d):
119            I_pre = np.eye(int(np.prod(sizes[:i])))
120            I_post = np.eye(int(np.prod(sizes[i + 1 :])))
121            P_i = np.kron(np.kron(I_pre, marg_S[i]), I_post)
122            TS_list.append(0.5 * (P_i + P_i.T))
123
124        S_scaled, _ = rescale_penalty(X_te, TS_list)
125        X_abs, self._penalties, self._Z = absorb_sum_to_zero_constraint(
126            X_te, S_scaled
127        )
128        self.n_coefs = X_abs.shape[1]
129
130    def build_columns(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
131        if self._Z is None:
132            self.compile(x)
133        marg_X = [
134            predict_smooth_basis(
135                np.asarray(x[:, feat], dtype=float).ravel(),
136                self._marginal_meta[i],
137            )
138            for i, feat in enumerate(self.features)
139        ]
140        return _khatri_rao(marg_X) @ self._Z
141
142    def build_penalties(self) -> List[np.ndarray]:
143        return [p.copy() for p in self._penalties]
144
145
146class _MgcvFactorTerm(_FactorTerm):
147    """Categorical factor term f(feature)."""
148
149    def __init__(self, feature: int, coding: str = "dummy") -> None:
150        super().__init__(feature, lam=0.0, coding=coding)
151
152
153_MgcvLinearTerm = _LinearTerm

155
156def instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[_MgcvTerm]:
157    """Instantiate mgcv term objects from parsed formula config dicts."""
158    terms: List[_MgcvTerm] = []
159    for cfg in configs:
160        kind = cfg["type"]
161        feats = cfg["features"]
162        kw = dict(cfg["kwargs"])
163
164        k_val = kw.pop("k", kw.pop("n_splines", 10))
165        sp_val = kw.pop("sp", kw.pop("lam", None))
166        bs_val = kw.pop("bs", "tp")
167
168        if kind == "s":
169            terms.append(
170                _MgcvSplineTerm(
171                    feature=feats[0],
172                    k=k_val,
173                    bs=bs_val,
174                    sp=sp_val,
175                    m=kw.pop("m", None),
176                    knots=kw.pop("knots", None),
177                    constraint=kw.pop("constraint", None),
178                )
179            )
180        elif kind == "te":
181            te_k = k_val if isinstance(k_val, (int, list)) else 5
182            terms.append(
183                _MgcvTensorTerm(
184                    features=feats, k=te_k, bs=bs_val, sp=sp_val
185                )
186            )
187        elif kind == "f":
188            terms.append(
189                _MgcvFactorTerm(
190                    feature=feats[0], coding=kw.pop("coding", "dummy")
191                )
192            )
193        elif kind == "l":
194            terms.append(_MgcvLinearTerm(feature=feats[0]))
195        else:
196            raise ValueError(f"Unknown term type '{kind}' in formula.")
197    return terms

  1"""Single-term penalised GAM — LinGAM class (mgcv backend)."""

  3from __future__ import annotations
  4
  5from typing import Optional, Tuple
  6
  7import numpy as np
  8from numpy.typing import ArrayLike
  9
 10from ._gam import GAMCore
 11from ._terms import _MgcvSplineTerm

 13
 14class LinGAM(GAMCore):
 15    """Penalised GAM for a single smooth term y = beta_0 + f(x) + eps (mgcv backend)."""
 16
 17    def __init__(
 18        self,
 19        n_splines: int = 10,
 20        lam: Optional[float] = None,
 21        spline_order: int = 3,
 22        constraint: Optional[str] = None,
 23        k: Optional[int] = None,
 24        sp: Optional[float] = None,
 25        bs: str = "tp",
 26        method: str = "REML",
 27        gamma: float = 1.0,
 28    ) -> None:
 29        if k is not None:
 30            n_splines = int(k)
 31        if sp is not None:
 32            lam = float(sp)
 33
 34        if constraint == "periodic":
 35            bs = "cc"
 36        elif constraint is not None:
 37            raise ValueError(
 38                f"Unsupported constraint '{constraint}' for mgcv backend. "
 39                "mgcv natively supports 'periodic' (bs='cc'). For soft shape "
 40                "constraints (monotonicity, convexity), use backend='pygam'."
 41            )
 42
 43        if n_splines < 3:
 44            raise ValueError("n_splines (k) must be at least 3.")
 45        if lam is not None and lam < 0:
 46            raise ValueError(
 47                "Smoothing parameter 'lam' / 'sp' must be non-negative."
 48            )
 49
 50        self.constraint = constraint
 51        self.edge_knots_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 52        self.knots_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 53
 54        bs_lower = bs.lower()
 55        m_param = (
 56            (int(spline_order) - 1, 2)
 57            if bs_lower in ("ps", "cp", "bs", "b")
 58            else None
 59        )
 60        lam_val = float(lam) if lam is not None else None
 61        super().__init__(
 62            f"s(0, k={int(n_splines)}, bs={bs_lower!r}, sp={lam_val!r}, m={m_param!r})",
 63            method=method,
 64            gamma=gamma,
 65            fit_intercept=True,
 66            spline_order=int(spline_order),
 67        )
 68
 69    @property
 70    def _term(self) -> _MgcvSplineTerm:
 71        return self._terms[0]  # type: ignore[return-value]
 72
 73    @property
 74    def n_splines(self) -> int:
 75        return self._term.k
 76
 77    @n_splines.setter
 78    def n_splines(self, val: int) -> None:
 79        self._term.k = int(val)
 80        self._term_configs[0]["kwargs"]["k"] = int(val)
 81
 82    k = n_splines
 83
 84    @property
 85    def lam(self) -> Optional[float]:
 86        return self._term.sp[0] if self._term.sp else None
 87
 88    @lam.setter
 89    def lam(self, val: Optional[float]) -> None:
 90        self._term.sp = [float(val)] if val is not None else None
 91        self._term_configs[0]["kwargs"]["sp"] = (
 92            float(val) if val is not None else None
 93        )
 94
 95    sp = lam
 96
 97    @property
 98    def bs(self) -> str:
 99        return self._term.bs
100
101    @property
102    def n_coefs(self) -> int:
103        """Effective number of model coefficients (smooth + intercept)."""
104        return len(self.coef_) if self.coef_ is not None else self.n_splines
105
106    @property
107    def design_matrix_(self) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
108        return self._design_matrix_
109
110    def __repr__(self) -> str:
111        status = "fitted" if self.is_fitted else "unfitted"
112        sp_str = f"sp={self.lam:.4g}" if self.lam is not None else "sp=auto"
113        cons_str = (
114            f", constraint='{self.constraint}'" if self.constraint else ""
115        )
116        return (
117            f"LinGAM(k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', {sp_str}, "
118            f"method='{self.method}'{cons_str}) [{status}]"
119        )
120
121    def _diagnostics_title(self) -> str:
122        return f"LinGAM Diagnostics (k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', sp={self.lam:.4f})"
123
124    def fit(self, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> "LinGAM":
125        """Fit the GAM model using mgcv REML or GCV criteria."""
126        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
127        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
128        if not np.all(np.isfinite(x_arr)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(y_arr)):
129            raise ValueError("Input data contains NaN or infinity.")
130        self.edge_knots_ = np.array(
131            [float(np.min(x_arr)), float(np.max(x_arr))]
132        )
133        cfg_sp = self._term_configs[0]["kwargs"].get("sp")
134        self._term.sp = [float(cfg_sp)] if cfg_sp is not None else None
135        super().fit(x_arr.reshape(-1, 1), y_arr)
136        meta = self._term._meta
137        xp = meta.get("xp") if meta.get("xp") is not None else meta.get("knots")
138        if xp is None:
139            xp = meta.get("Xu")
140        self.knots_ = (
141            np.asarray(xp)
142            if xp is not None
143            else np.linspace(
144                self.edge_knots_[0], self.edge_knots_[1], self.n_splines
145            )
146        )
147        return self
148
149    def gridsearch(
150        self,
151        x: ArrayLike,
152        y: ArrayLike,
153        n_splines: Optional[ArrayLike] = None,
154        lam: Optional[ArrayLike] = None,
155        gamma: float = 1.0,
156    ) -> "LinGAM":
157        """Select optimal basis dimension k (and optionally lam) via REML or GCV."""
158        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).ravel()
159        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
160        k_list = [
161            int(v)
162            for v in np.atleast_1d(
163                np.arange(5, 25, 2) if n_splines is None else n_splines
164            )
165        ]
166        lam_list = (
167            [None]
168            if lam is None
169            else [float(v) for v in np.atleast_1d(lam)]
170        )
171        best_score, best_k, best_lam = np.inf, self.n_splines, self.lam
172
173        for k_cand in k_list:
174            for l_cand in lam_list:
175                try:
176                    cand = LinGAM(
177                        n_splines=k_cand,
178                        lam=l_cand,
179                        bs=self.bs,
180                        method=self.method,
181                        gamma=gamma,
182                        spline_order=self.spline_order,
183                    ).fit(x_arr, y_arr)
184                    if cand.statistics_["score"] < best_score:
185                        best_score = cand.statistics_["score"]
186                        best_k = k_cand
187                        best_lam = cand.lam if l_cand is None else l_cand
188                except Exception:
189                    continue
190
191        self.n_splines = best_k
192        self.lam = best_lam
193        return self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
194
195    def plot_decomposition(
196        self,
197        x: ArrayLike,
198        y: ArrayLike,
199        n_grid: int = 300,
200        figsize: Tuple[int, int] = (16, 5),
201    ) -> Tuple:
202        """Plot basis decomposition, coefficients, and overall fit."""
203        k_smooth = self._term.n_coefs
204        return self._plot_lingam_decomposition(
205            x,
206            y,
207            k_smooth=k_smooth,
208            prefix="b",
209            basis_title=f"Basis Functions (dim={k_smooth})",
210            fit_title="Overall Model Fit",
211            suptitle=f"LinGAM Decomposition (k={self.n_splines}, bs='{self.bs}', sp={self.lam:.4f}, method={self.method})",
212            show_weighted=False,
213            n_grid=n_grid,
214            figsize=figsize,
215        )

  1"""Multi-term GAM with formula interface and REML/GCV optimization (mgcv backend)."""
  2
  3from __future__ import annotations
  4
  5from itertools import product as cartesian_product
  6from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
  7
  8import numpy as np
  9from numpy.typing import ArrayLike
 10from scipy import stats
 11
 12from .._base import _GAMBase
 13from .._formula import parse_formula
 14from ._optimizer import fit_mgcv_engine
 15from ._terms import (
 16    _MgcvLinearTerm,
 17    _MgcvSplineTerm,
 18    _MgcvTensorTerm,
 19    _MgcvTerm,
 20    instantiate_mgcv_terms,
 21)
 22
 23
 24class GAMCore(_GAMBase):
 25    """Multi-term Generalized Additive Model with formula interface (mgcv backend)."""
 26
 27    _scale_is_var = True
 28
 29    def __init__(
 30        self,
 31        formula: str,
 32        method: str = "REML",
 33        gamma: float = 1.0,
 34        fit_intercept: bool = True,
 35        spline_order: int = 3,
 36    ) -> None:
 37        self.formula = formula
 38        self.method = method.upper()
 39        self.gamma = float(gamma)
 40        self.fit_intercept = bool(fit_intercept)
 41        self.spline_order = int(spline_order)
 42
 43        configs = parse_formula(formula)
 44        self._term_configs = configs
 45        self._terms: List[_MgcvTerm] = instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs)
 46
 47        self._coef_slices: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
 48        self.coef_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 49        self.statistics_: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
 50        self._design_matrix_: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 51
 52    def __repr__(self) -> str:
 53        status = "fitted" if self.is_fitted else "unfitted"
 54        return f"GAMCore(formula='{self.formula}', method='{self.method}') [{status}]"
 55
 56    def fit(self, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> "GAMCore":
 57        """Fit multi-term GAM model using REML or GCV criteria."""
 58        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
 59        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
 60        if not np.all(np.isfinite(x_arr)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(y_arr)):
 61            raise ValueError("Input data contains NaN or infinity.")
 62        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
 63            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
 64
 65        self._compile(x_arr)
 66        self._compute_coef_slices()
 67        X = self._build_model_matrix(x_arr)
 68        self._design_matrix_ = X
 69        p = X.shape[1]
 70
 71        S_list: List[np.ndarray] = []
 72        sp_fixed: List[Optional[float]] = []
 73
 74        for i, term in enumerate(self._terms):
 75            start, end = self._coef_slices[i]
 76            pens = term.build_penalties()
 77            term_sps = term.sp if term.sp is not None else [None] * len(pens)
 78            for pen_idx, P_sub in enumerate(pens):
 79                P_full = np.zeros((p, p), dtype=float)
 80                P_full[start:end, start:end] = P_sub
 81                S_list.append(P_full)
 82                sp_fixed.append(
 83                    term_sps[pen_idx] if pen_idx < len(term_sps) else None
 84                )
 85
 86        fit_res = fit_mgcv_engine(
 87            X=X,
 88            y=y_arr,
 89            S_list=S_list,
 90            sp_fixed=(
 91                sp_fixed if any(sp is not None for sp in sp_fixed) else None
 92            ),
 93            method=self.method,
 94            gamma=self.gamma,
 95            coef_slices=self._coef_slices,
 96            M_p=1 if self.fit_intercept else 0,
 97        )
 98
 99        self.coef_ = fit_res["coef"]
100
101        sp_idx = 0
102        for term in self._terms:
103            n_pens = len(term.build_penalties())
104            if n_pens > 0:
105                term.sp = fit_res["sp"][sp_idx : sp_idx + n_pens]
106                sp_idx += n_pens
107
108        self.statistics_ = {
109            "edof": fit_res["edof"],
110            "edof_per_coef": fit_res["edof_per_coef"],
111            "scale": fit_res["scale"],
112            "cov": fit_res["Vp"],
113            "Vp": fit_res["Vp"],
114            "Ve": fit_res["Ve"],
115            "se": fit_res["se"],
116            "rss": fit_res["rss"],
117            "deviance": fit_res["deviance"],
118            "null_deviance": fit_res["null_deviance"],
119            "deviance_explained": fit_res["deviance_explained"],
120            "r_sq_adj": fit_res["r_sq_adj"],
121            "n_samples": fit_res["n_samples"],
122            "GCV": fit_res["GCV"],
123            "score": fit_res["score"],
124            "method": fit_res["method"],
125            "sp": fit_res["sp"],
126            "edf_per_term": fit_res["edf_per_term"],
127            "f_stat_per_term": fit_res["f_stat_per_term"],
128            "p_values_per_term": fit_res["p_values_per_term"],
129        }
130        return self
131
132    def gridsearch(
133        self,
134        x: ArrayLike,
135        y: ArrayLike,
136        n_splines_grids: Optional[List[ArrayLike]] = None,
137        gamma: float = 1.0,
138    ) -> "GAMCore":
139        """Search over candidate basis dimensions k for smooth terms via REML/GCV."""
140        x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
141        y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float).ravel()
142        if x_arr.ndim == 1:
143            x_arr = x_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
144
145        smooth_indices = [
146            i
147            for i, t in enumerate(self._terms)
148            if isinstance(t, (_MgcvSplineTerm, _MgcvTensorTerm))
149        ]
150        if not smooth_indices or n_splines_grids is None:
151            return self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
152
153        best_score = np.inf
154        best_combo = None
155
156        for combo in cartesian_product(*n_splines_grids):
157            configs_copy = [dict(cfg) for cfg in self._term_configs]
158            for idx_in_smooth, term_i in enumerate(smooth_indices):
159                cfg = configs_copy[term_i]
160                cfg["kwargs"] = {
161                    **cfg.get("kwargs", {}),
162                    "k": combo[idx_in_smooth],
163                }
164            cand_model = GAMCore(
165                formula=self.formula,
166                method=self.method,
167                gamma=gamma,
168                fit_intercept=self.fit_intercept,
169                spline_order=self.spline_order,
170            )
171            cand_model._terms = instantiate_mgcv_terms(configs_copy)
172            cand_model._term_configs = configs_copy
173            try:
174                cand_model.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
175                if cand_model.statistics_["score"] < best_score:
176                    best_score = cand_model.statistics_["score"]
177                    best_combo = combo
178            except Exception:
179                continue
180
181        if best_combo is not None:
182            for idx_in_smooth, term_i in enumerate(smooth_indices):
183                cfg = self._term_configs[term_i]
184                cfg["kwargs"] = {
185                    **cfg.get("kwargs", {}),
186                    "k": best_combo[idx_in_smooth],
187                }
188            self._terms = instantiate_mgcv_terms(self._term_configs)
189
190        return self.fit(x_arr, y_arr)
191
192    def summary(self) -> str:
193        """Formatted summary table matching R mgcv's summary.gam."""
194        self._check_fitted()
195        n = self.statistics_["n_samples"]
196        score_name = "REML" if self.method == "REML" else "GCV"
197        score_val = self.statistics_["score"]
198
199        lines = [
200            "",
201            "Family: gaussian ",
202            "Link function: identity ",
203            "",
204            f"Formula: {self.formula}",
205            "",
206        ]
207
208        param_rows = []
209        df_res = max(n - self.statistics_["edof"], 1.0)
210        if self.fit_intercept:
211            b0 = self.coef_[-1]
212            se0 = self.statistics_["se"][-1]
213            t0 = b0 / max(se0, 1e-12)
214            p0 = 2.0 * (1.0 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t0), df=df_res))
215            param_rows.append(("(Intercept)", b0, se0, t0, p0))
216
217        for i, t in enumerate(self._terms):
218            if isinstance(t, _MgcvLinearTerm):
219                start, _ = self._coef_slices[i]
220                b = self.coef_[start]
221                se_b = self.statistics_["se"][start]
222                tb = b / max(se_b, 1e-12)
223                pb = 2.0 * (1.0 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(tb), df=df_res))
224                param_rows.append((f"l({t.feature})", b, se_b, tb, pb))
225
226        if param_rows:
227            lines.append("Parametric coefficients:")
228            lines.append("            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)")
229            for name, b, se_b, tb, pb in param_rows:
230                lines.append(
231                    f"{name:11s} {b:10.4f} {se_b:10.4f} {tb:7.3f} {pb:8.4g}"
232                )
233            lines.append("")
234
235        smooth_rows = []
236        for i, t in enumerate(self._terms):
237            if isinstance(t, (_MgcvSplineTerm, _MgcvTensorTerm)):
238                if isinstance(t, _MgcvSplineTerm):
239                    label, ref_df = f"s({t.feature})", t.k - 1
240                else:
241                    label = f"te({','.join(str(f) for f in t.features)})"
242                    ref_df = t.n_coefs
243                smooth_rows.append(
244                    (
245                        label,
246                        self.statistics_["edf_per_term"][i],
247                        ref_df,
248                        self.statistics_["f_stat_per_term"][i],
249                        self.statistics_["p_values_per_term"][i],
250                    )
251                )
252
253        if smooth_rows:
254            lines.append("Approximate significance of smooth terms:")
255            lines.append("        edf Ref.df      F p-value")
256            for label, edf, ref_df, f_stat, pval in smooth_rows:
257                lines.append(
258                    f"{label:7s} {edf:6.2f} {ref_df:6d} {f_stat:6.3f} {pval:8.4g}"
259                )
260            lines.append("")
261
262        lines.extend(
263            [
264                f"R-sq.(adj) = {self.statistics_['r_sq_adj']:.4f}   Deviance explained = {self.statistics_['deviance_explained'] * 100:.1f}%",
265                f"{score_name} = {score_val:10.4f}  Scale est. = {self.statistics_['scale']:.4f}   n = {n}",
266                "",
267            ]
268        )
269        return "\n".join(lines)
270
271    def plot_decomposition(
272        self,
273        x: ArrayLike,
274        y: ArrayLike,
275        n_grid: int = 200,
276        figsize: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None,
277        feature_names: Optional[List[str]] = None,
278    ) -> Tuple:
279        """Plot partial dependence for all terms in the GAM."""
280        return self._plot_gamcore_decomposition(
281            x,
282            y,
283            n_grid=n_grid,
284            extrap_frac=0.0,
285            figsize=figsize,
286            feature_names=feature_names,
287        )
